name: Donald Trump
description: Follow Donald Trump, a tracked person, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: IRS targets private schools that help racial minority students
changes.summary: The Trump administration has said it will end the tax-exempt status for universities with programs that help racial minority students.

changes.title: Work set to begin in Trump's plan for triumphal arch
changes.summary: NPR's Steve Inskeep speaks with New York Times reporter Emily Badger about the Trump administration's plans to move forward with construction of a triumphal arch.

changes.title: Trump already tried to hurt Iran with sanctions once - and it didn't work
changes.summary: President Trump is again hoping to use economic pressure to force Iran to the negotiating table.

changes.title: Election expert on the impact of Trump's appeal to SCOTUS on mail-in ballots
changes.summary: NPR's Steve Inskeep asks David Becker, an elections administration expert, what effect the Trump administration's appeal to the Supreme Court on mail-in ballots could have on the midterms.

changes.title: Trump administration asks Supreme Court to weigh in on mail-in ballots
changes.summary: Mail ballots are now being sent to certain states as questions linger about new restrictions ahead of the midterms. CBS News' Olivia Rinaldi reports.

changes.title: What app surged in downloads after Trump's 'Lake America' change? The quiz knows
changes.summary: Plus: George Santos is back in the news!

changes.title: Can a ‘Prairie Populist’ Democrat Win a Senate Seat in Trump’s Iowa?
changes.summary: Josh Turek is trying to turn deep-red Iowa blue as he runs for the U.S. Senate.

changes.title: North Carolina Set to Mail The Fall’s First Ballots As Trump Tries to Restrict Them
changes.summary: A federal judge has temporarily blocked a Postal Service rule that could impede millions of mail voters. The Trump administration has asked the Supreme Court to weigh in.

changes.title: The U.S. Wants the Oil From These 17 Venezuelan Fields
changes.summary: A private oil company has struck a deal with the Trump administration to develop 17 areas in Venezuela, an effort that experts say will take years and billions of dollars.

changes.title: Wesleyan president calls Trump's tax-exempt proposal 'extraordinary overreach'
changes.summary: The Trump administration wants to end tax-exempt status for universities with certain race-based programs. Wesleyan President Michael Roth says the plan could frighten schools. (Image credit: DenisTangneyJr).
